data.title: Account Age vs Transaction Volume Mismatch
data.description: Detects accounts less than 90 days old that exhibit transaction volumes exceeding the typical profile for mature accounts. Newly opened accounts with abnormally high volume are a primary indicator of purpose-built mule accounts created specifically to funnel illicit funds.

detection.condition: selection and selection_high_volume | count() by account_id > 20

falsepositives: Legitimate new business accounts with immediate high transaction needs
Student accounts receiving financial aid disbursements at semester start
